title: Cops Find Woman with Her Heart Cut Out
description:
Bodycam footage captures a disturbing scene in Tallahassee, Florida, after police respond to reports of a naked woman wandering a neighborhood. Officers encountered 58-year-old Earleen Tucker outside her home without clothing and attempted to assist her back inside to get dressed. Once inside the residence, investigators made a horrifying discovery—an apparent organ lying on the floor near the front door, later confirmed to be a human heart. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
